notes: All seven web searches ran this time (the six required plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act). None returned any statement by Rep. Jonathan L. Jackson (IL-1) about AI risk; results about Rep. Jeff Jackson (NC) and Rep. Ronny Jackson (TX) were excluded as different people. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026): the FastDemocracy bill page (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/) lists 12 cosponsors and he is not among them; Congress.gov returned HTTP 403, so this was not confirmed there. No House letter about AI risk led by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). A third-party legislation tracker (LegiPlex) lists an 'Artificial Intelligence Civil Rights Act of 2025' (introduced 3 December 2025) and the CREATE AI Act of 2023 among his bills, but the page returned HTTP 403 so his role was not checked; these are about civil rights and research resources, not catastrophic risk, and would be level D at most. From the earlier attempt (still valid): his official press release listing pages (https://jonathanjackson.house.gov/media/press-releases, pages 1 to 8) covering January 2025 to 9 November 2026 had no title or excerpt mentioning AI, and the In the News page 1 had nothing on AI; only titles and excerpts were checked, not full release texts. Hearing remarks and floor speeches were not checked individually.
